components.shared: scripts/gate-prep/lib/guardrails.mjs - fail-closed helpers (production-hostname/action guards, test-mode-key guard, livemode guard, database-identity guard, recipient-allowlist guard, secret redaction) every other script imports rather than reimplementing
components.cloudflare_access: scripts/gate-prep/cloudflare-access-setup.mjs (idempotent create-or-update of the Admin/Client Access apps+policies+AUDs from config/access-config.mjs, DRY_RUN supported) + access-smoke-test.mjs (post-deployment unauthenticated-rejection + optional authenticated-pass checks against the live preview hostname)

components.stripe_sandbox: scripts/gate-prep/stripe-sandbox-provision.mjs (idempotent product/price/portal-configuration creation from config/stripe-plans-config.mjs, refuses any non sk_test_/rk_test_ key before any network call) + stripe-validation-suite.mjs (automated Sandbox scenarios runnable standalone vs. ones that need a live deployed preview, clearly separated)
components.resend_preview: scripts/gate-prep/lib/resend-dispatch.mjs (the actual dispatch layer - environment-guarded, allowlist-enforced, idempotent via outbound_message_events, defaults to a suppressed no-network-call mode unless SEND_FOR_REAL=1) + resend-preview-dispatch.mjs (CLI runner exercising all six templates against a local in-memory D1)
components.orchestrator: scripts/gate-prep/orchestrator.mjs - runs every gate script in order, stops at the first failure without advancing, and resumes from the last-passed gate on the next run (or an explicit --from=<gate>)

verified_this_pass: Every script fails closed with a clear, non-stack-trace message when required credentials are absent (confirmed for all of: cloudflare-access-setup, d1-migrate, stripe-sandbox-provision, stripe-validation-suite, resend-preview-dispatch, orchestrator)
assertTestModeStripeKey genuinely rejects a live-shaped key before any Stripe API call is attempted (confirmed live, not just by code review)
d1-migrate.mjs's database-identity guard correctly rejects a mismatched database name

CORRECTED in a follow-up read-only pass: d1-migrate.mjs's initial claim that all four migrations were unapplied was based only on `wrangler d1 migrations list`, which reads an empty bookkeeping table and cannot see that 0001/0002's actual schema is already fully present live. Direct schema inspection (sqlite_master, PRAGMA table_info, row counts matching the known fixture) confirmed 0001 and 0002 are genuinely already applied; only 0003/0004 are truly absent. d1-migrate.mjs was hardened with classifyMigrationDrift() to catch this class of drift before ever calling `wrangler d1 migrations apply` again - 8 new regression tests lock in the exact scenario discovered here

20 unit tests total in tests/phase-f-gate-prep.test.mjs (12 covering every guardrails.mjs function, 8 covering classifyMigrationDrift's five states plus the exact real-world scenario) - 95/95 total suite passing

A real bug was found and fixed in d1-migrate.mjs's own JSONC parser: a naive `//`-comment-stripping regex matched the `//` inside the `https://` URL in wrangler.preview.jsonc's PUBLIC_SITE_URL value and corrupted the JSON - replaced with a string-aware stripper

Confirmed directly (live HTTP probes, not inference): the deployed preview's auth entry points (POST /api/ops/auth/admin, POST /api/ops/auth/client) both return 503 identity_provider_not_configured - Cloudflare Access configuration, not database state, is what blocks every authenticated route today. Non-session-creating endpoints (GET /api/ops/session, GET /api/ops/portal) return 401 with no cookie, never reaching the Access check. No one has been able to create a real authenticated session against the live preview - only local/demo-mode rendering (isSafeProductPreview()) has ever functioned there, exactly as documented all along
